global_assumptions: All rates are modelled as monthly cashback on a single statement cycle.
Base-rate cashback is not counted against a card's monthly cap.
Once a card's bonus cap is reached, further spend on that card earns its base rate.
If a card's total cycle spend is below its minimum spend, every category falls back to the base rate.

cards.name: DBS Live Fresh
assumptions: Models the 5% online/contactless tier as a flat 5% on Shopping, Dining and Transport.
Single $20 monthly bonus cap (the real card splits its cap across tiers).

cards.name: UOB One Card
assumptions: The real card pays a quarterly rebate on quarterly spend bands; v1 approximates it as a monthly minimum spend of $500 with flat category rates.
Monthly bonus cap set to $50 (a third of the quarterly rebate band).

cards.name: OCBC 365
assumptions: Weekday/weekend dining rates are modelled as a single 6% dining rate.
Per-category sub-caps are modelled as one $80 monthly cap.

cards.name: Flat 1.5% Cashback Card
assumptions: Unconditional 1.5% on all spend, no minimum spend and no cap. Acts as the fallback card in the wallet.
